description: The Google Ads rules Hermoso runs for this brand, each with a one-sentence summary, ON/OFF, last run and outcome, next run, whether it CAN RAISE SPEND, and its scopeToken; plus each account's caps. Rules made in the Google Ads web UI are not listed: Google exposes them to no API. Read-only. Free.
name: list_google_ads_rules
title: List Google Ads automated rules
